messages:
elaine: Originating RC rc-2026-03-22-B (sha: 9a7b3c). Target promo window 18:00-19:00 UTC. Need quick signoffs: keystore rotate, KV bake, smoke tests, release notes. Pin before prod. @rob run KV bake on prod-shadow pls.

rob: Started KV bake. warmed 40 shards, hit_rate=0.91, mem=69%. saw one transient 502 during warm, retried automatically.
```
2026-03-22T16:02:01Z kv-warm: shards=40 hit=0.91 transient_502=1 mem=69%
```

qa-bot: Smoke results: token_checks 195/200, e2e proxy ok, error_rate delta +0.03%. Two formatting edge cases flagged.

sam: Release notes updated with logits-normalization note and client migration hint. +1.

elaine: Keystore rotated to kms-main-04 and decryption probe passed. Secrets-manager entry verified. Pinning now.

deploy-bot: /pin rc-2026-03-22-B -> pinned (pin_id=pin-10011, artifact=9a7b3c)

elaine: Starting canary: /promote rc-2026-03-22-B --to canary --percent 10 --duration 20m --pin

deploy-bot: Canary job 10012 started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/10012/logs

ops-oncall: Watching. thresholds: errors +0.5% abs, latency p95 +20%.

(20m later)

ops-oncall: Canary metrics stable. error_delta +0.02, token_checks 199/200. Recommend staged prod promote 25->60->100 with 5m gaps.

elaine: Starting staged promote. /promote rc-2026-03-22-B --to prod --staged --stages 25,60,100 --pin

deploy-bot: Stage 1 -> 25% applied.

deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> 60% applied.

rob: Observed brief spike in upstream 502 retries at stage 2 in eu-west. Ops confirmed upstream backoff bump in 4m. Holding before final stage.

(4m)

ops-oncall: Upstream fix live. Proceeding to final stage.

deploy-bot: Stage 3 -> 100% applied. Promotion complete. rc-2026-03-22-B is live. :tada:

elaine: Post-promote checks running 30m. Rollback snippet if needed:
```
/promote rc-2026-02-28-zz --to prod --pin --force
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-service --to-revision=1987
curl -X POST https://feature-gate.prod/flags/llm-service -d '{"enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

qa-bot: No alerts in 15m. I'll update release notes with canary summary and close thread when window clears.
